findings.body: Raise: Not done. Replies without numbered items no longer keep today's rule. The base parser accepts `**No findings.**\nNote: tests weren't run.`, but the new `[said]` fallback combines both lines into one string that cannot match `empty`, recording a failed round and requiring a disposition for a clean review. The existing command test's expectation is changed from True to False at tests/test_read_accepts_no_findings.py:39, so the reported 60 passing cases conceal this regression for both client histories. The same fallback also rejects previously accepted unnumbered bullet lists such as `- No findings.\n- No issues found.`. The shipped guidance and proof list describe the narrower replacement rule rather than proving the required preservation.
